st.headline: Mid-scale Holiday Inn in Cavenagh Road to reopen as luxury hotel The Hari Singapore in 2027
st.teaser: The Hari brand is part of IHG Hotels & Resorts' luxury and lifestyle brand Vignette Collection.
fullText: SINGAPORE – One of Orchard Road’s longest-standing hotels, the Holiday Inn Singapore Orchard City Centre in Cavenagh Road, will reopen as luxury hotel The Hari Singapore in 2027.

The existing 324-room Holiday Inn Singapore hotel, which first opened in 1985, sits between Kramat and Cavenagh roads, and is behind Cuppage Plaza. Holiday Inn is one of the flagship hotel brands owned and operated by IHG Hotels & Resorts, formerly known as InterContinental Hotels Group.

Currently under renovation, the new hotel is slated to open in the first quarter of 2027, marking The Hari brand’s debut in Singapore and its third worldwide. The Hari London opened in August 2016, while The Hari Hong Kong opened in December 2020.
It is a brand of luxury boutique hotels created by Harilela Group, with interiors designed by British designer Tara Bernerd.

Bernerd – whose portfolio includes the Four Seasons Hotel in Florida and London, as well as residential projects in New York, London and Hong Kong – will oversee the transformation of the mid-scale Holiday Inn Singapore into a five-star establishment.
The Hari brand is part of IHG’s luxury and lifestyle brand Vignette Collection, which was launched in 2021.
The Hari hotels are part of a three-hotel portfolio deal between IHG and Hong Kong-based Harilela Group, a hotel development and management company with a portfolio spanning Asia and Europe.
Under the franchise agreement, the 85-room The Hari London and 210-room The Hari Hong Kong will come under Vignette Collection.

This agreement is an expansion of an existing partnership between IHG and Harilela Group, which includes Holiday Inn Golden Mile in Hong Kong, Holiday Inn Express Changzhou Center and Holiday Inn Bangkok Silom.

Aron Harilela, chairman and chief executive officer of the Harilela Group, said in a media statement on Aug 17 that bringing The Hari hotels into the Vignette Collection provided the opportunity for a unified brand partnership and leveraged IHG’s scale, global reach and commercial strength.
“We have a clear and ambitious vision for The Hari brand, with plans to expand its footprint in major international destinations,” he added.

Rajit Sukumaran, IHG’s senior vice-president and managing director for East Asia and the Pacific, said: “This landmark agreement introduces Vignette Collection to one of the world’s most strategically important gateway cities and expands its presence in both London and Hong Kong.
“The Hari hotels are renowned for their distinctive and understated luxury stays, making them a natural fit for the Vignette Collection .”

IHG intends for the Vignette Collection to build up its portfolio to more than 100 hotels by 2031. As at Aug 17, there are 38 hotels in 17 countries in its portfolio, with another 46 properties in the pipeline.
Recent openings include The One Shanghai Downtown and Palm Springs Hotel Chengdu, both in China. Upcoming additions include the Mangala Estate Kuantan in Malaysia and Vaagali Maldives.

Vivek Bhalla, IHG’s managing director for South-east Asia and South Korea, said that while The Hari Singapore is located towards the end of Orchard Road and hemmed in by older buildings such as Cuppage Plaza and Orchard Plaza, its proximity to Emerald Hill and place within a precinct that continues to evolve will reinforce its long-term appeal.

“Today’s luxury travellers are increasingly seeking hotels with a strong sense of individuality, character and place. When it opens in 2027, The Hari Singapore, Vignette Collection will offer a truly differentiated luxury proposition in one of Asia’s most vibrant cities ,” he said.
Though the Singapore dollar has remained robust against regional currencies, Bhalla said travel is among the most resilient of discretionary spending areas for consumers.
He noted that the Republic has always been a competitive hotel market in the region, and that the group believes success in luxury hospitality is driven by differentiation.
“One significant shift we’re seeing is of travellers increasingly seeking authentic, local and purpose-driven experiences. This has led to a rise of lifestyle-led hotels and collection brands.”
He added that the quick expansion of Vignette Collection reflects this, with hotel conversions accounting for 43 per cent of IHG’s openings and 49 per cent of signings in the first half of 2026.
“There’s a clear opportunity to go further,” he said. “Singapore is a strategically important market for IHG and we see opportunities to expand our portfolio across all segments here.”
IHG has Hotel Indigo Changi Airport in the pipeline, a 255-room property scheduled to open in 2028. As part of the upper upscale, lifestyle hotel brand, the hotel will pay homage to Changi Airport.

cna.headline: More than 180,000 without power in Hawaii, 100 homes damaged as Lala weakens to tropical storm
cna.teaser: More than 180,000 without power in Hawaii, 100 homes damaged as Lala weakens to tropical storm
fullText: More than 180,000 utility customers remained without power across Hawaii on Sunday (Aug 16) afternoon after Hurricane Lala brushed the Big Island before being downgraded to a tropical storm.
Some 183,123 customers across Hawaii were without power as of 3.30pm, according to poweroutage.us
Outages in Oahu, the most populated island, had dropped from more than 220,000 to about 130,000 as of Sunday morning, state officials said during a press conference.
State officials received reports of at least 100 homes damaged, Hawaii Governor Josh Green said on Sunday.
A tropical storm warning remained in effect for Kauai county, although those warnings for Maui and Oahu counties were discontinued earlier on Sunday, according to the hurricane centre.
The weather agency's projections indicate that if the storm remains on its expected path, it should be clear of Hawaii's islands by 8am on Monday.
Hawaiian Electric had warned customers on Saturday evening that repair efforts were being hampered as hurricane-force winds toppled trees and rain flooded roadways.
Lala had battered parts of Hawaii with flash floods "like we've never seen", a state official said.
State officials also urged residents to stay indoors after at least one person was reported dead in a car-related accident.
"It's not a day to go to the beach," one official said during a press conference on Sunday morning.
Video released by the Hawaii Department of Transportation showed flood waters overtaking roads. Two homes were swept away, according to the National Weather Service.
About 117 people were in shelters as of Sunday morning, officials said.
The Hawaii Department of Transportation said that all airports have been reopened, but state officials advised travellers to check with their airlines for updates.

listening.title: Singapore's Push for National EV Charger Network
listening.transcript: As Singapore charges ahead with its green plan, the Land Transport Authority has accelerated the installation of electric vehicle charging points in public housing estates. Commuters in HDB towns like Yishun and Jurong will soon find charging slots within a short walk from their homes. This rapid deployment aims to address range anxiety among potential EV buyers. Authorities believe that making charging accessible will nudge more drivers to ditch internal combustion engine cars.

economistArticle.title: The Grand Unwinding: Japan's Yen Rescue and the Carry Trade
paras: For decades, the global financial system operated on a remarkably reliable dynamic: borrow cheaply in Japan, where interest rates remained stubbornly below zero, and invest the proceeds in higher-yielding assets elsewhere. This practice, known as the yen carry trade, pumped hundreds of billions of dollars into global markets, inflating asset prices from American tech stocks to emerging-market bonds. But when the Bank of Japan decided to step in and aggressively buy its own currency, it signaled the beginning of a perilous unwinding process.

The mechanics of the carry trade rely heavily on a weak yen and a predictable interest-rate differential. Investors sell the borrowed yen for foreign currencies to make their investments, putting downward pressure on the Japanese currency. However, when the Bank of Japan intervenes to prop up the yen, the math suddenly changes. A rapidly appreciating yen forces traders to buy back the currency to close out their positions, triggering a stampede that can destabilize global financial markets.

This intervention is not merely a technical adjustment; it represents a fundamental shift in Japan's macroeconomic strategy. Confronted with rising import costs and persistent domestic inflation, Tokyo has found that tolerating a weak yen is no longer politically or economically tenable. By buying yen and raising interest rates, policymakers are attempting to restore purchasing power to Japanese consumers, though the domestic benefits may come at the expense of international financial stability.

As the world's largest creditor nation, Japan's actions reverberate across borders. Institutional investors and hedge funds, accustomed to cheap leverage, are now scrambling to adjust their portfolios. The sudden withdrawal of yen liquidity threatens to expose vulnerabilities in highly leveraged sectors worldwide, serving as a stark reminder of how interconnected and fragile the global financial architecture remains.
economistArticle.cn:
几十年来，全球金融体系一直运行在一个非常可靠的动态机制上：在利率一直顽固维持在零度以下的日本低成本借款，然后将所得资金投资于其他地区收益率更高的资产。这种被称为“日元套利交易”的做法向全球市场注入了数千亿美元，推高了从美国科技股到新兴市场债券的资产价格。但是，当日本银行决定介入并积极购买本国货币时，它标志着一个危险的解套过程的开始。
套利交易的机制严重依赖于疲软的日元和可预测的利差。投资者卖出借入的日元换取外币进行投资，从而对日本货币施加了贬值压力。然而，当日本银行干预以提振日元时，计算公式突然发生了变化。日元迅速升值迫使交易员回购日元以平仓，从而引发了一场可能破坏全球金融市场稳定的踩踏式平仓潮。
这种干预不仅仅是一次技术性调整；它代表了日本宏观经济战略的根本转变。面对不断攀升的进口成本和持续的国内通胀，东京方面发现，容忍弱势日元在政治上或经济上已不再可行。通过购买日元和提高利率，政策制定者正试图恢复日本消费者的购买力，尽管国内的益处可能会以牺牲国际金融稳定为代价。
作为全球最大的债权国，日本的举动在跨境产生回响。习惯了廉价杠杆的机构投资者和对冲基金现在正争先恐后地调整其投资组合。日元流动性的突然抽离可能会暴露全球高杠杆行业的脆弱性，这无异于一次严厉的警示，提醒人们全球金融架构是多么相互关联和脆弱。

gems.s: For decades, the global financial system operated on a remarkably reliable dynamic: borrow cheaply in Japan, where interest rates remained stubbornly below zero, and invest the proceeds in higher-yielding assets elsewhere.
gems.why: This sentence utilizes a colon to elegantly introduce a detailed explanation of a complex dynamic, breaking down a sophisticated financial concept into a clear, parallel structure. 这句话利用冒号优雅地引入了对复杂动态的详细解释，将复杂的金融概念拆解为清晰且对称的句式结构。

gems.s: A rapidly appreciating yen forces traders to buy back the currency to close out their positions, triggering a stampede that can destabilize global financial markets.
gems.why: This sentence uses a present participle clause ('triggering a...') to seamlessly connect a cause with its dramatic, long-term consequence, enhancing flow and impact. 这句话使用现在分词短语（'triggering a...'）将起因与戏剧性的长期后果无缝连接，增强了行文的流畅度与表现力。
